justification: Elevation from B+ to high based on aggregate adverse-media review (AIP summary action_id ams-2026-05-15-CP-SYNTH-00042). Three open signals concentrated in 90-day window: civil complaint at pleadings stage (AM-003), highest individual count on the Q1 regulator named-firms list (AM-004), and unaddressed disclosure pattern in Q1 revenue announcement (AM-002 vs AM-001/AM-003). The complaint and the regulator-named pattern together warrant elevation; the disclosure gap reinforces the elevation but is not by itself sufficient. Not elevated to critical given absence of enforcement-action trigger and pleadings stage of the civil matter. Will re-review at the 2026-Q3 portfolio cycle or earlier if either matter escalates substantively.
